patch_description:
This version combines the stronger global-objective greedy placement from the current program with the lightweight pressure-based ordering from the inspiration program. It evaluates several deterministic model orderings, keeps the best feasible initial placement, then improves it using memory-feasible single-model moves and swaps.

The greedy phase minimizes the resulting maximum KVPR at every assignment rather than only considering current pressure. Multiple orderings improve robustness for heterogeneous model sizes and request rates, while the local rebalance phase can correct greedy placement decisions without changing the input/output interface.
